newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht eases, interbank steady late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht eases, interbank steady late.

text.p: The Thai baht eased during late Wednesday trade on higher local commercial demand for dollar, dealers said.
The baht was quoted at 31.90/32.10 per dollar in the local market against 31.40/70 in the morning. The baht at one point dipped below 32.00 to the dollar.
"There appears to have some corporate demand and local banks have been buying (dollar) in the spot market," said a trader at a foreign bank.
